metadata.case_name: CHAN CHUNG KEUNG v. GREENROLL LTD T/A CONRAD HONG KONG

plaintiff.occupation_before: Bar Captain at the Conrad Hotel

injuries.description: Soft tissue contusion / sprain of the lower back
source: The diagnosis was soft tissue contusion of the lower back.
He describes it as a back sprain for which he was treated conservatively and appropriately with rest, medication, regular physiotherapy and occupational therapy.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: Degenerative change of lumbar discs with mild bulging at L4-5 and signal change/dehydration at L3-4 and L4-5
source: A MRI had been done in September 2003 which showed degeneration of L4-5 disc with no significant nerve root compression.
This showed the following: (ii) Signal change of dehydration at L3-4 and L4-5 discs; (iii) Mild bulging L4-5 disc; (iv) No nerve root compression;
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: Numbness in left thigh and hip; numb left leg and thigh
Bilateral lower limb pain (left more severe than right)
Pain aggravated by fast walking, prolonged sitting (>20-30 minutes), sustained posture or lifting heavy objects
Walking tolerance about 60 minutes and sitting tolerance about 30 minutes
Pain waking him at night (3-4 am) average 3-4 nights a week
Unable to lift up a bucket of water to mop floor

treatments_received: attendances at A&E (Queen Mary Hospital, Violet Peel Clinic, OLMH)
medical assessment by Medical Assessment Board
treatments_future: may require treatment on a need-to basis in future

losses.description: Persistent low back pain with reduced ability to lift, walk fast, or sit for prolonged periods; resulted in limitations in activities and psychological problems (depression).

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Unable to lift up a bucket of water to mop floor.
